requirements.text: * Experience: a BS degree (or equivalent professional experience) in Computer Science or a related engineering field, with at least 2 years of experience building backend systems or AI/ML pipelines (internships and research count).
* Coding skill: strong proficiency in at least one programming language (e.g., Python, Rust, Go, Java, C#), and you write clean, tested, maintainable code.
* Systems fundamentals: a solid grasp of distributed systems concepts (concurrency, networking, caching, load balancing, failure modes), and an interest in going deeper.
* Interest in performance: you have profiled, benchmarked, or tuned a service or pipeline and can explain what you changed and why it helped.
* Curiosity: you want to know how things work under the hood, and you keep going on hard problems until you understand them.
* **Nice to have**: experience with containers and orchestration (Kubernetes, Nomad), observability tools (Prometheus, Grafana), or applying ML/forecasting to operational data.
* A Learner: you take in feedback quickly, look for mentorship, and grow your scope over time.
* A Partner: you know the best tools fit into the existing tooling ecosystem. You approach partners with curiosity and work to understand a problem before you start coding.
* A Problem Solver: you ask good questions, form hypotheses, and use data to test them.
* Dependable: you break your work into milestones, estimate honestly, and keep your team updated on progress and blockers.
* A Team Player: you contribute to code reviews, documentation, and shared team goals, and you help make long-running projects succeed.
